# pipeline-analytics-sdk-php

> API reference for pipeline-analytics-sdk-php, a PHP client for
> [pipeline-analytics](https://github.com/alrayyes/pipeline-analytics)'s
> REST API. Generated from the upstream OpenAPI spec with openapi-generator's
> `php` target, wrapped in a hand-written `Client` facade over a Guzzle HTTP
> transport with retries and pagination. This site is the generated
> phpDocumentor API reference; for usage examples, authentication and
> installation, see the [source repository](https://github.com/alrayyes/pipeline-analytics-sdk-php)
> README.

Requires PHP 8.2+ and a running pipeline-analytics instance. Every endpoint
except `getVersion` and the webhook receivers needs a session cookie, since
the upstream API authenticates with WebAuthn rather than an API token.

## API reference

- [Client class](classes/PipelineAnalytics-Client.html): the hand-written
  facade — constructor, retry/backoff options, and the per-tag API
  properties (`repos`, `pipelines`, `insights`, `auth`, `webhooks`).
- [PipelineAnalytics namespace](namespaces/pipelineanalytics.html): the
  hand-written layer (`Client`, `ApiError`) that wraps the generated code.
- [PipelineAnalytics\Exception namespace](namespaces/pipelineanalytics-exception.html):
  typed error handling around the generated client's exceptions.
- [PipelineAnalytics\Pagination namespace](namespaces/pipelineanalytics-pagination.html):
  the pagination iterator used by list endpoints like `listRepos`.
- [PipelineAnalytics\Retry namespace](namespaces/pipelineanalytics-retry.html):
  the exponential-backoff retry policy for `429`/`5xx` responses.
- [File index](indices/files.html): every documented source file, generated
  and hand-written.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/alrayyes/pipeline-analytics-sdk-php):
  README, CONTRIBUTING.md (regenerating the client), and the OpenAPI spec
  this SDK is generated from.
